name: Path of the Berserker
description: Turn battle fury into relentless offense through reckless, rage-fueled attacks.

3.name: Frenzy
3.description: Reckless Attack can add extra damage to the first Strength-based hit on your turn while Rage is active.

name: College of Lore
description: Collect broad expertise and turn sharp observation into a defense for your allies.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: Gain proficiency in three additional skills.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: Use Bardic Inspiration and a Reaction to reduce a nearby creature's successful attack roll, ability check, or damage roll.

name: Life Domain
description: Channel divine power toward restoration, endurance, and keeping wounded companions in the fight.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: Healing spells cast with a spell slot restore additional Hit Points.

3.name: Life Domain Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate Life Domain spells as always-prepared spells.

3.name: Preserve Life
3.description: Spend Channel Divinity to divide a pool of healing among Bloodied creatures nearby.

name: Circle of the Land
description: Draw adaptable magic and restorative power from the environment around you.

3.name: Circle of the Land Spells
3.description: Choose a land connection after a Long Rest to gain its always-prepared spells.

3.name: Land's Aid
3.description: Spend Wild Shape to harm nearby foes while restoring an ally's Hit Points.

name: Champion
description: Refine physical training into broader critical hits and stronger athletic performance.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

3.name: Remarkable Athlete
3.description: Gain Advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
description: Control enemies with precise techniques delivered through Flurry of Blows.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.description: Flurry of Blows hits can prevent reactions, push a target, or knock it Prone.

name: Oath of Devotion
description: Swear a formal oath centered on justice, duty, compassion, and honorable conduct.

3.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate oath spells as always-prepared spells.

3.name: Sacred Weapon
3.description: Spend Channel Divinity to empower a held weapon with divine accuracy and light.

name: Hunter
description: Study dangerous prey and adapt your attacks to exploit the opening it gives you.

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.description: Hunter's Mark reveals useful weaknesses, resistances, and immunities of the marked creature.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.description: Choose a specialized offensive technique and change that choice after a rest.

name: Thief
description: Turn speed, dexterity, and practical tricks into control over objects, locks, traps, and terrain.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: Use a Bonus Action for certain Sleight of Hand checks, Utilize actions, and eligible magic items.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Gain a Climb Speed and use Dexterity for longer jumps.

name: Draconic Sorcery
description: Manifest durable draconic magic through protective scales, vitality, and inherited spells.

3.name: Draconic Resilience
3.description: Increase maximum Hit Points and gain a natural Armor Class formula while unarmored.

3.name: Draconic Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate draconic spells as always-prepared spells.

name: Fiend Patron
description: Draw dangerous resilience and destructive magic from a bargain tied to the Lower Planes.

3.name: Dark One's Blessing
3.description: Gain Temporary Hit Points when an enemy falls nearby or by your hand.

3.name: Fiend Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate Fiend Patron spells as always-prepared spells.

name: Evoker
description: Specialize in shaping raw magical energy with efficient study and reliable damaging cantrips.

3.name: Evocation Savant
3.description: Add two eligible Evocation spells to your spellbook without paying their normal transcription cost.

3.name: Potent Cantrip
3.description: Damaging cantrips still deal partial damage when an attack misses or a target succeeds on its save.
